channel.title: Utrecht Beslist — City Council Decisions (Housing & Living)
channel.description: Utrecht city council decisions and documents explained in plain language.

item.title: Environmental plan update Pijlsweerd, Lauwerecht, Vogelenbuurt, Tuinwijk
item.description: The council is adopting the second amendment to the Utrecht environmental plan. This converts ten zoning plans in Noordwest and Noordoost into the definitive environmental plan and adds rules on soil quality and archaeology.

item.title: Adjustment to registration duration extension for priority groups
item.description: The college is adjusting the flex-housing experiment framework for residents of Place2BU and Goeie Buur. Registration duration extension will now be variably determined based on allocation figures to enable moving to a new home.

item.title: Environmental plan Jan van Galenstraat-Huizingalaan-Van Ginnekenlaan
item.description: The Gemeenteraad is deciding on the TAM environmental plan for Jan van Galenstraat, Huizingalaan, and Van Ginnekenlaan. This enables the construction of 102 rental homes, a supermarket, retail units, and an underground parking garage.

item.title: Adjustment Housing Ordinance
item.description: The city of Utrecht wants to adjust the Housing Ordinance. This is related to the registration period for progression after temporary attention groups.

item.title: Adjustment Housing Ordinance
item.description: The city of Utrecht wants to adjust the Housing Ordinance. This means that people who live temporarily in a house will have more time to find a new home.

item.title: Environmental plan Jan van Galenstraat-Huizingalaan-Van Ginnekenlaan
item.description: The Gemeenteraad is deciding on the TAM environmental plan for Jan van Galenstraat, Huizingalaan, and Van Ginnekenlaan. This enables the construction of 102 rental homes, a supermarket, retail units, and an underground parking garage.

item.title: Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026
item.description: The college presents the Multi-Year Spatial Perspective 2026 detailing spatial investments. It includes budgets for affordable housing, accessibility, green spaces, and preparation credits for redevelopment projects.
